headline: Dinesh Thakkar files Regulation 31(4) substantial acquisition disclosure in Angel One Limited
sum: Dinesh Thakkar has filed a SEBI Reg. 31(4) disclosure of substantial acquisition of shares in Angel One Limited, signalling a material stake or voting change requiring immediate exchange notification under the Takeover Regulations.
detail: Angel One Limited, a listed financial services company on NSE, has received a Regulation 31(4) disclosure from Dinesh Thakkar indicating a substantial acquisition of shares. Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 requires disclosure within 2 working days of acquisition of shares crossing 5% or acquisition of voting rights crossing 2%. The exact stake, consideration, and timeline of the underlying acquisition are not disclosed in the headline filing; further detail requires review of the full Regulation 31(4) form filed with NSE. This filing is a precursor to potential further regulatory action under the Takeover Code.
